# befday

> curated birthday perks, free treats, secret vouchers, and step-by-step redemption guides in malaysia.

## overview
befday is an open directory and guide to verified birthday perks across food & beverage, entertainment, convenience stores, and attractions in malaysia.

## main sections
- [homepage](https://befday.com/): all verified birthday perks and freebies
- [blog](https://befday.com/blog): in-depth strategy guides, redemption walkthroughs, and tips

## verified birthday perks
- [starbucks malaysia](https://befday.com/perks/starbucks-malaysia): complimentary slice of cake with any handcrafted beverage purchase for starbucks rewards members (entire birthday month).
- [boost juice malaysia](https://befday.com/perks/boost-juice-malaysia): free birthday juice or smoothie for vibe club members (birthday +/- 2 days).
- [familymart malaysia](https://befday.com/perks/familymart-malaysia): free sofuto soft-serve ice cream in any flavor via famiport app (entire birthday month).
- [tgv cinemas](https://befday.com/perks/tgv-cinemas): 2 free movie tickets and a regular popcorn combo for movieclub members (entire birthday month).
- [gsc cinemas](https://befday.com/perks/gsc-cinemas): 2 complimentary cinema tickets for selected movies plus exclusive combo coupons for gsc rewards members (entire birthday month).
- [sunway lagoon](https://befday.com/perks/sunway-lagoon): discounted theme park passes, merchandise savings, and vip benefits for loyalty and passport members (birthday period).
